sn47.18:1.1: Ekaṃ samayam Bhagavā Uruvelāyaṃ viharati najjā Nerañjarāya tīre Ajapālanigrodhe pathamābhisambuddho || || 2.
sn47.18:1.2: Atha kho Bhagavato rahogatassa paṭisallīnassa evaṃ cetaso parivitakko udapādi || ||
sn47.18:1.3: Ekāyano yam maggo sattānam visuddhiyā sokaparidevānam samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānam atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yad idaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā ||
sn47.18:2.2: Kāye vā bhikkhu kāyānupassī vihareyya || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vinneyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.18:2.5: Dhammesu vā bhikkhu dhammānupassī vihareyya || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.18:2.6: Ekāyano yam maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānam atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā ti || || 4.
sn47.18:3.1: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati Bhagavato cetasā cetoparivitakkam aññāya seyyathāpi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāham pasāreyya pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya || evam eva kho Brahmaloke antarahito Bhagavato purato pāturahosi || ||
sn47.18:3.2: Atha kho Brahmā sahampati ekaṃsam uttarāsaṅgaṃ karitvā yena Bhagavā tenañjalim paṇāmetvā Bhagavantam etad avoca || || 5.
sn47.18:3.3: Evam etam Bhagavā evam etaṃ Sugata ||
sn47.18:3.4: ekāyano yam bhante maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānam samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānam atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yadidaṃ cattāro satipaṭṭhānā ||
sn47.18:4.2: Kāye vā bhante bhikkhu kāyanupassī vihareyya || ātāpī sampajāno satimā || vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ ||
sn47.18:4.5: Dhammesu vā bhante dhammānupassī vihareyya || ātāpī sampajāno satimā vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ || ||
sn47.18:4.6: Ekāyano yam bhante maggo sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānam samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānam atthagamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya yad idam cattāro satipaṭṭhānāti || || 6.
sn47.18:5.2: idaṃ vatvā Brahmā sahampati athāparam etad avoca || ||
